text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered: 5m 429 rate for /v1/embeddings crossing threshold (current 4.1%). Top callers: tenant-a, tenant-b. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/embeddings/429s?from=now-15m
maria: acked. I'm watching dashboards and logs. Any ongoing deploys?
ashwin (oncall): I'm oncall, ack. pulling logs now.
priya: Not seeing deployments in the last 30m. Looks like a traffic pattern spike from tenant-a — sudden QPS jump.
emily: Confirmed, tenant-a has a 10x spike in concurrent requests from a single IP pool.
ashwin (oncall): Plan: immediate containment = 1) soft-rate-limit tenant-a to 0.4 qps 2) disable embeddings-batching for public routes 3) enable 429 fallback route for search clients. If that looks fine I'll execute.
maria: +1 to soft-rate-limit and disable batching. Keep changes surgical.
priya: I'll prepare the commands.
ashwin (oncall): Running rate limit change:```
# internal traffic-shaper
traffic-shaper set --tenant tenant-a --qps 0.4 --burst 30 --reason "surge containment 429s"
# response: ok. applied to cluster pool A
```
ops-bot: Action recorded by runbook: surge-containment -> rate-limiter bumped (tenant-a) by ashwin at 2026-03-15T10:24:54Z
priya: Disabling batching flag for embeddings endpoint:```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/flags/embeddings_batching" -d '{"tenant":"tenant-a","enabled":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_PLANE_TOKEN"
# resp: {"status":"ok","flag":"embeddings_batching","value":false}
```
emily: Pushed a temporary rule to API gateway to enforce 429->503 fallback for heavy requests to /v1/embeddings.
ashwin (oncall): Monitoring: Grafana link again https://grafana.redwood.net/d/embeddings/429s?from=now-5m ; initial 429 rate dropped to 2.0% after 30s, now 1.1% and descending.
maria: Customer impact check: Support report pipeline shows 12 incidents opened by tenant-a's users (webhooks delayed). Not yet a P1.
emily: Noting: embeddings pipeline backlog increased briefly; KV cache evictions spiked.
priya: Rolling back some large concurrent batch requests via tenant-support-bot: ``tenant-support-bot: queued 23 in-flight requests for manual cancel for tenant-a``
tenant-support-bot: Requested cancellations issued, 18 succeeded, 5 already completed.
ashwin (oncall): Can we safely remove the batching disable once 429s < 0.5% for 5m?
maria: Yes. Also let's keep the soft-rate-limit for another 10m after steady state.
ashwin (oncall): Noted. I'll handoff in 20m to emily unless further escalation.
emily: I'll take followup. If rates creep back up, escalate to infra for temporary quota-enforcement throttle at load-balancer level.
priya: Adding a quick postmortem note to the incident channel and tagging infra. snippet: "cause: sudden tenant-a traffic spike from 3rd-party job; mitigation: soft-rate-limit + disable batching + gateway fallback; impact: transient 429s, delayed webhooks."
deploy-bot: No active deploys flagged in last 60m.
ashwin (oncall): Final check: current 429 0.4% over 5m, error budget within tolerance. Keeping mitigation in place for 12 more minutes then revert batching if stable.
maria: Thanks team. Logging actions in runbook and notifying customer success to reach out to tenant-a. :white_check_mark: 
emily: I'll take post-handoff monitoring. handing off to emily at 10:43 UTC.
emily: ack, taking ownership and will update if anything changes.
ops-bot: Incident thread closed (mitigations applied, monitoring ongoing).
